references.text: Moses asks for a leader who can lead the people, similar to the desire to have control over the people
The elders of Gilead ask Jephthah to become their commander, parallel to military leadership and challenge
Goliath challenges the army of Israel to battle, similar to a challenge to military confrontation
Goliath and David exchange challenges before the fight, parallel to Gaal's challenge against Abimelech
Military gathering and challenge to battle at Gilgal
Joshua challenges the tribe of Ephraim to take the land, similar to an appeal for military action
